runtime.note: 后端、模型契约及前端资源来自启动时固定快照；任务数据与凭据独立使用原目录。Python依赖环境仍共用，不是完整依赖隔离。

checks: build page downloads current revision ZIP with type-bound filename
run page provides the same one-step package
unsaved plan disables package without saving or dispatching
wrong revision response rejected without file download
leaving scope during response preparation cancels late download
actual API refuses old revision query
refresh preserves saved task and performs no automatic download or writes

limitations: Archive only includes existing local artifact and report, not a complete business acceptance signoff.
Manifest hashes provide byte consistency, not cryptographic signature or trusted provenance.
Legacy artifacts without recorded build hash only prove bytes at export; no migration or original-build integrity claim.
Known credential patterns are refused; arbitrary business text is not a comprehensive sensitive-data detector; review before sharing.
No real Dify execution or new model semantic validation.
